Title: Prohibits local laws from requiring certain storefront security gates or grilles comply with certain conditions
Summary: Prohibits local laws from requiring certain storefront security gates or grilles comply with certain conditions; extends the provisions concerning existing storefront security gates or grilles.
LawCode: Add §399-ww, Gen Bus L; amd §28-315.7.1, NYC Ad Cd
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general business law and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protecting small businesses and commercial property owners from local mandates requiring the replacement of certain storefront security gates or grilles, and extending the compliance deadline for existing storefront security gate or grille visibility requirements
